title: 5G NR LDPC typestate builder preset
description:
## Goal

5G NR LDPC chain preset via the typestate builder: any
(BG, lifting set, rate) in scope expressible with compile-time
parameter check.

## Context

Task under story `a5635da5` (5G NR LDPC real-time and research
enablers) within epic `gf2-sim` (`f9717e7e`). Placeholder body —
project-lead expands during claim.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Project-lead expands this section with verifiable
  acceptance conditions consistent with the parent story's
  deliverables and the epic's architecture contract.
- [hard] 5G NR LDPC chain expressible via the typestate builder
  for every (BG, lifting set, rate) combination in scope;
  compile-time error on invalid parameter combinations.

## Non-goals

See epic `f9717e7e` non-goals.
